title: Rapid-Fire Touch Passing
description: One player in the middle receives and returns passes from three teammates around them as fast as possible, sharpening hands and reaction.

content.objective: Catch and return passes instantly with soft hands, building quick reactions and touch.
content.setup: Groups of four: one player in the middle, three outside in a semicircle three metres away, two balls.
content.organization: 30 seconds in the middle, then rotate.
instructions: Two outside players hold a ball.
The middle player receives a pass and returns it immediately to the player without a ball.
The next pass comes straight away from another outside player.
Keep the two balls moving for 30 seconds.
Rotate so everyone takes a turn in the middle.
coachingPoints: Soft hands: give with the catch.
Return the ball to the player with empty hands.
Stay low and on the balls of the feet.
commonMistakes: Catching against the chest and losing the ball.
Returning to a player who already has a ball.
Outside passers throwing before the middle player is ready.
content.safety: Chest passes only, not too hard; the middle player calls 'stop' if overwhelmed.
progressions: Middle player must use one-hand returns.
regressions: Outside players say the middle player's name before passing.
variations: Middle player faces away and turns on a call.
successCriteria: Returns go to the correct player every time.
content.gameApplication: Quick hands help players handle hard, unexpected passes in traffic.
